name: Being A Good Example
overview: Scripture teaches that being a good example involves living a transformed life that reflects God's will and glorifies Him through good works, as Jesus instructs in Matthew 5:16. Believers are called to follow God as His children (Ephesians 5:1) and to let the word of Christ richly dwell within them, guiding their speech and actions (Colossians 3:16-17). This godly influence begins with training others in the way of the Lord (Proverbs 22:6) and is sustained by a continual renewal of the mind to discern and demonstrate what is good and acceptable to God (Romans 12:2).
